title: F1: remove/document 13 cargo-machete unused-dependency hits
description: Verify each of the 13 cargo machete hits across finima-feed/api/ingest/db/llm/auth; remove genuinely unused deps or add package.metadata.cargo-machete ignored with rationale.
acceptance_criteria: cmd: cargo machete; cmd: cargo build --workspace; cmd: cargo test --workspace

title: A1: build-once via cargo nextest archive
description: Introduce a nextest-archive producing job; backend-test (and llm-test when enabled) consume the archive instead of recompiling from scratch.
acceptance_criteria: grep: nextest archive in .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep: archive-file in .github/workflows/ci.yml

title: C2: parallelize backend-lint and backend-test
description: Remove 'needs: backend-lint' from backend-test and llm-test; add a ci-success aggregation job requiring all jobs.
acceptance_criteria: grep:absent: needs: backend-lint in .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep: ci-success in .github/workflows/ci.yml

title: A4: configure lld fast linker
description: Add .cargo/config.toml with -Clink-arg=-fuse-ld=lld and install lld on the runner.

title: C1: add concurrency cancel-in-progress group
description: Add a concurrency: {group, cancel-in-progress: true} block to ci.yml so superseded PR pushes cancel.

title: D2: harden upload-artifact steps
description: Add if-no-files-found: ignore to the playwright-report and playwright-traces upload-artifact steps (ci.yml:258,264).

title: A3: set CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 / CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0
description: Add both env vars to .github/workflows/ci.yml top-level env: block.
acceptance_criteria: grep: CARGO_INCREMENTAL.*0 in .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep: CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG.*0 in .github/workflows/ci.yml

title: A6: cargo-audit via taiki-e/install-action
description: Replace 'cargo install cargo-audit --locked' (ci.yml:116) with taiki-e/install-action for a prebuilt binary.
acceptance_criteria: grep: taiki-e/install-action in .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep:absent: cargo install cargo-audit in .github/workflows/ci.yml

title: CI/CD optimization (rust-optimizer audit)
description: Apply OPTIMIZATION_SPEC.md findings A1,C2,A3,A4,A6,C1,D2,F1 to .github/workflows and Cargo dependency hygiene.
